```sh
kafka cluster reassign execute
```

Execute a partition reassignment from a kafka-reassign-partitions.sh-shaped JSON file

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

The reassignment file supplies target replicas. --dry-run previews the parsed plan; log_dirs entries are reported as ignored.

## Before you run

Moves partition replicas and can increase network/disk load. Save the current assignment before applying so a deliberate reverse plan can be submitted.

## Flags

| Flag                   | Description                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`   | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                                       |
| `--from-file <string>` | path to a JSON file in the kafka-reassign-partitions.sh --reassignment-json-file shape |
| `--timeout <number>`   | request timeout in ms                                                                  |
| `--dry-run`            | print the planned reassignment and exit without connecting                             |
| `--yes`                | confirm the reassignment without an interactive prompt                                 |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster reassign execute --from-file reassignment.json --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "topic": "events",
      "partition": 0,
      "ok": true
    }
  ],
  "logDirsIgnored": false
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
